title: WorldCore: Integrations
summary: Use region and hazard data to inform maps, weather, routes, missions, and recovery plans.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Ashfall uses WorldCore heavily, WeatherCore can add pressure, HoloMap can show context, and Index or Wiki can link the same region to items and missions.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Ashfall routes, WeatherCore pressure, HoloMap overlays, Wiki articles, and Index records together so world context becomes actionable.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If helper layers are missing, use landmarks, biome changes, and hazard behavior as your field guide. The world still shows its rules.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
